name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: A middleware-ready Agent platform starter kit running Codex CLI locally or on Volcengine ECS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.proofs: npm run build -w @launchpad/server && node scripts/demo-passport.mjs && node scripts/demo-escalation.mjs && node scripts/demo-memory-poison.mjs && node scripts/demo-egress.mjs && node scripts/demo-tunnel-bypass.mjs && node scripts/demo-kill.mjs
scripts.proofs:no-engine: npm run build -w @launchpad/server && node scripts/demo-passport.mjs && node scripts/demo-escalation.mjs && node scripts/demo-memory-poison.mjs
